short_description: NextGen PHOENIX atmospheres, Teff 900-10,000 K (SVO NextGen2; Hauschildt, Allard & Baron 1999)
description: SVO's NextGen2 grid, "The NextGen Model grid of theoretical spectra" (Hauschildt, Allard & Baron 1999): PHOENIX model atmospheres for cool stars and brown dwarfs, Teff 900-10,000 K, log g 3.0-6.0, [M/H] -4.0 to 0.0. It is not SVO's NextGen ("NextGen (solar)", 272 spectra), the grid whose SVO copy is about 100 times too bright above 5,000 K; that grid is not on NJM. This copy's fluxes equal SVO's raw 2025 files exactly.
